    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    DebugManager
    DebugManager is a tool created specifically for development to keep track of collisions, add debugs tools to speed up testing, and track performance
    EndScreen
    Screen displayed at the end of the game.
    Entity
    Entity stores a Sprite, a collision geometry Circle, and its centre, and rotation.
    GameManager
    GameManager is the class that manages most aspects of the gameplay itself, keeping track of Geese through GooseManager, the student using Student, etc.
    GameMap
    GameMap manages the tile map, detects collisions checks for Circles, holds collision information via an array of Rectangles, and decides were the Student appears at spawn
    GameScreen
    Screen displayed during the main loop of the game.
    Goose
    Goose class.
    Goose.State
    State is a list of the states a goose can be in
    GooseManager
    GooseManager manages the geese that appear in the game, storing them as an Array of Goose.
    HiddenEvent
    HiddenEvent stores a single instance of a secret event in the map, Each instance is managed together by the HiddenEventManager
    HiddenEvent.EventType
    EventType stores the types of events possible
    HiddenEventManager
    HiddenEventManager controls when hidden events (HiddenEvent) get triggered and keeps track of how many are triggers, which ones are left to be triggered
    Item
    The item class stores an item, whether in the student inventory or actively on the ground.
    ItemData
    ItemData stores information about items as a single contained unit to make transfer of item data easier.
    ItemType
    ItemType enumerates possible items (including a "missing item" type).
    Lwjgl3Launcher
    Launches the desktop (LWJGL3) application.
    Main
    ApplicationListener implementation shared by all platforms.
    MapSettings
    MapSettings stores the state of the map to choose between the two maps
    Projectile
    Projectile objects are flying entities which go across the map and eventually land somewhere.
    ScreenAdapter
    Top Level Screen class that implements LibGDX's Screen interface.
    SettingsScreen
    Screen to handle changing settings, can be accessed from multiple places and handles returning to the correct one
    SetupScreen
    The Setup screen for the game where the user selects difficulty and day/night mode Also shows the tutorial infographic
    SfxMusic
    SfxMusic stores Sound objects for sound effects, and a Music object for the music
    StartupHelper
    A helper object for game startup, featuring three utilities related to LWJGL3 on various operating systems.
    Student
    Student class.
    StudentController
    StudentController manages inputs for a given Student
    TitleScreen
    THe Title screen displayed when the application first launches, or when returning from a game.
    Wave
    Wave stores information about each wave.
    WaveManager
    WaveManager controls the waves mechanic of the game, handling timings and the placement of geese for each wave.
